iconNote: Texture names (ability_warrior_charge) from Interface/ICONS. Serve large 56px JPEGs from the Wowhead CDN (wow.zamimg.com). INV_MISC_QUESTIONMARK and numeric FileDataIDs fall back to inv_misc_questionmark. In-game, GetMacroIcons() lists the same set. Do not ship Blizzard BLP files.

groups.title: Shared core
groups.description: General-tab utilities that need a macro: assist, focus, trinket slots, and cursor items. Put potions, the hearthstone, and racials on the bar. Class spells stay in class groups.

groups.title: Warrior core
groups.description: Useful macros for non-talent Warrior abilities. Load this complete set on the General tab; named gear swaps stay character-specific.

groups.title: Warrior Arms
groups.description: Only active abilities unlocked by Arms talents.

groups.title: Warrior Fury
groups.description: Useful macros for Fury talent abilities. Piercing Howl needs no wrapper; drag the spell itself to an unmanaged slot.

groups.title: Warrior Protection
groups.description: Only active abilities unlocked by Protection talents. A Fury/Protection build usually adds only Last Stand; Concussion Blow and Shield Slam require deeper Protection talents.

groups.title: Tazzy gear kit
groups.description: Character-specific Nightslayer Tazzy cooldown and equipment macros. Swap this group when the gear kit changes.

groups.title: Mage filler
groups.description: Existing Currentz fillers. /cqs and [nomod]/[mod:shift] downranks stay.

groups.title: Currentz kit
groups.description: Character-specific Currentz. Touch of Chaos wand and named Naxx shells. Generic Shoot stays in mage-filler.

groups.title: Mage control
groups.description: Kicks, sheep, block, decurse. Existing bodies win.

groups.title: Mage burst
groups.description: Existing SpellQueueWindow + trinket + PoM set. Do not shorten.

groups.title: Mage ports Alliance
groups.description: Existing Currentz IF/SW plus Darnassus from the plan. Shift = portal.

groups.title: Mage ports Horde
groups.description: Existing WARKEYS Orgrimmar / Undercity / Thunder Bluff.

groups.title: Paladin Retribution
groups.description: Alliance Era ret. Seal + judge + stun + consecrate.

groups.title: Paladin Holy
groups.description: Heals. Alt self. Shift cheap rank.

groups.title: Hunter core
groups.description: Mark, shots, Feign Death, pet. 18 or fewer.

groups.title: Auden pet kit
groups.description: Character-specific Auden. Worg Carrier from the 372399535 account.

groups.title: Rogue Combat
groups.description: Openers, Kick, finishers. /startattack on builders.

groups.title: Priest Holy / Disc
groups.description: Alt self. Shift cheap rank. Ctrl Rank 1. Mouseover on dispel.

groups.title: Priest Shadow
groups.description: Dots and form. Cancel form to heal.

groups.title: Shaman Enhancement
groups.description: Horde Era. Shock interrupt uses /stopcasting and Rank 1 on Shift.

groups.title: Warlock core
groups.description: Life Tap, bolts, curses, Spell Lock, summon announce (existing `sum`).

groups.title: Druid Feral
groups.description: Cat/bear. /cancelform before heals. Form numbers: 1 bear, 3 cat.

groups.title: Druid Balance / Resto extras
groups.description: Moonkin and healer extras.
